scope: Nonlinear Hamiltonian solved on reflection-even S^3 scalar data, Kij=0, scalar proper-time momentum=0; momentum constraints vanish exactly.
normal_expansion: On the initial Kij=0 slice, Gaussian-normal Raychaudhuri gives Theta_dot=V/M^2>0 exactly; scalar spatial-gradient terms cancel in rho+S. This is a normal geodesic volume turn, not a scalar matter-flow frame (gradient is spacelike at the slice).
regularity: Smooth positive conformal factor and scalar data imply finite initial connection/curvature and local regular Einstein-scalar continuation; no global completeness or later stability theorem.
attribution: Same constraints/normal turn occur in the torsion-free canonical-scalar equivalent theory; this strengthens the curvature-assisted interpretation, not a Level B torsion-bounce claim.
